long_biography.plain_text:
Before Direct Wonen, Yvonne Swaans and her partner Richard Westerhuis tested an early childcare venture. When they opened De Kamer Balie in Eindhoven in 1990, one day's revenue of a thousand guilders convinced them the model could scale. The service grew into a 30-branch rental-housing network and adopted the Direct Wonen name.

The founders retained control when the company entered London's Alternative Investment Market, and their vehicle later held more than three-quarters of the shares. Following a voluntary market exit, the enterprise evolved into Qmulus, which now manages its own capital through US-market strategies, property investments and stakes in selected companies. Swaans has stepped back from operational leadership to work as a shareholder and investor.
